subject.title: Session lane starvation: followup drain monopolizes session lane, blocks inbound dispatch for 20-30min

question: What scheduler semantics should OpenClaw use when fresh user/channel turns arrive while follow-up or background work is draining the same session?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the durable fix must choose how to balance foreground responsiveness against transcript ordering, collect batching, cancellation, and existing followup behavior.

options.title: Foreground-yielding drain
options.body: Fresh user-visible turns preempt or pause background/followup drain work while preserving queued delivery context and transcript ordering invariants.

options.title: Bounded FIFO batches
options.body: Keep FIFO semantics but cap consecutive followup drain work and reschedule the remainder so fresh work gets periodic admission.

options.title: Keep strict FIFO
options.body: Leave the current model intact and document long same-session waits as expected for followup-heavy sessions.

recommendation.title: Foreground-yielding drain
recommendation.body: Fresh user-visible turns preempt or pause background/followup drain work while preserving queued delivery context and transcript ordering invariants.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent #100205 work touched the same foreground/followup admission boundary and is the closest current maintainer context.
